newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Santos plans onshore gas expansion.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Santos plans onshore gas expansion.

text.p: Oil and gas producer and explorer Santos Ltd said it planned to expand the Queensland portion of its Cooper Basin acreage to satisfy gas demand from emerging projects.
"It is our firm intention to prove up more gas and significantly add to our reserves base," Santos commercial manager Rod Rayner told a gas industry development conference.

Santos expected to find a further 1,000 petajoules of gas in the Queensland sector of the Cooper Basin in the next five to seven years, over and above current proven and probable reserves of 1,500 petajoules, Rayner said.
"We are optimistic about the commercial and geological prospects and we have stepped up our exploration effort substantially," Rayner said.
Santos had already tendered for drilling rigs in 1997 and expected to have up to three rigs operating full-time on gas exploration and development in the area, he said.
"This will be on top of an active oil development programme," Rayner said.
